steps.label: 1762-hml-inventory-last-page-click
command: (() => {const a=document.querySelector('.pagination a[aria-label="맨 뒤"]');if(!a||a.closest('li').classList.contains('disabled'))throw Error('Last page unavailable');const request=a.getAttribute('hx-get');a.click();return {action:'Open observed last page of HML inventory',request};})()
